sloka: तुष्टः पुष्टश्च सर्वो ऽसौ मानितश्च यथाविधि ।प्रीतिं यास्यति धर्मज्ञ शीघ्रमामन्त्र्यतां जनः ।। ७.९१.१८ ॥
transliteration: tuṣṭaḥ puṣṭaśca sarvo 'sau mānitaśca yathāvidhi ।prītiṁ yāsyati dharmajña śīghramāmantryatāṁ janaḥ ।। 7.91.18 ॥

translations.english: O knower of dharma, let all those people be quickly invited, so that they will be satisfied, nourished, and properly honored, thereby attaining great joy.
